name: Kreativ Report Broken Link
description: Let visitors flag broken links and manage their reports in WordPress.
cardUse: Collect visitor reports, track fixes, and export a CSV.
metaDescription: Let visitors report broken links, manage reports in WordPress, and export a CSV. This plugin does not automatically scan your site.

detailItems.title: Visitor reports, not an automatic scanner
detailItems.body: Adds a report button to enabled post types. Visitors flag a page that needs attention; the plugin does not crawl or automatically check links.

detailItems.title: A dashboard for follow-up
detailItems.body: Review the reported page, resolve, ignore, or reopen reports. Optional notifications and CSV export help you keep the cleanup work organized.

items.title: Pair feedback with your maintenance routine
items.body: Visitor reports tell you where someone noticed a problem. They do not prove every link is healthy. Use a separate crawler if you need automatic URL checks.

changelog.label: Status refresh
changelog.body: Plugin page copy and public metadata were refreshed to align with the current Kreativ WP release and maintenance messaging.

changelog.label: Release note link added
changelog.body: The plugin page now links directly to a dedicated update post instead of sending visitors to the generic news index.

quickStart: In WordPress, open Plugins → Add New Plugin and search for “Kreativ Report Broken Link”, or upload the ZIP. Install and activate it on staging first.
Open Kreativ Broken Links → Settings and choose which post types should show the report button. Check the notification email before enabling notifications.
Open a published post as a visitor and use “Report broken links on this page”. It reports the page; it does not automatically scan URLs.
Open Kreativ Broken Links → Reports, inspect the reported page, repair its links, and mark the report resolved. Export CSV when sharing a cleanup list.
